<mxfile host="make-drawio-svg" type="device"><diagram id="page-1" name="Load skill content and resources only when needed"><mxGraphModel dx="800" dy="600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="340" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="metadata" value="DISCOVER
Name + description" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2ff;strokeColor=#6b96cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="35" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="body" value="INVOKE
SKILL.md body" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1ebfb;strokeColor=#9b7ac3;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="380" y="35" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="reference" value="READ AS NEEDED
Reference files" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff3db;strokeColor=#c59b4f;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="790" y="35" width="290" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="script" value="EXECUTE
Bundled scripts" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3f6fa;strokeColor=#b5c1cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="380" y="220" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="result" value="RETURN
Focused output" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e6f4ec;strokeColor=#68a485;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="790" y="220" width="290" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="unloaded" value="Other skill bodies
can stay unloaded" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="220" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e1" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="metadata" target="body"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e2" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="body" target="reference"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e3" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="body" target="script"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e4" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="script" target="result"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.title: Load skill content and resources only when needed
svg.desc: The host exposes a skill catalog. Invocation loads the skill body. References enter context when read, not just linked. A script can execute without a source read; its invocation and returned summary still contribute context. Loaded content can persist across turns.
